enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe rhythmically. Turn to left side. Bend knees. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Stretch arms. Snore. Turn to back. Remain still. Breathe slowly. Turn to left again. Pull blanket.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, showering and washing up
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Sit up. Swing legs out of bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Pick up soap. Lather body. Rinse. Pick up shampoo. Apply to hair. Rinse hair. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Hang towel.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating breakfast, having coffee
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Turn on kitchen light. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs, milk, bread. Close refrigerator. Place items on counter. Open cupboard. Take out bowl, plate, mug. Close cupboard. Crack eggs into bowl. Whisk eggs. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Pour eggs into pan. Stir eggs. Toast bread. Pour coffee into mug. Sit at table. Pick up fork. Eat eggs.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and packing bag for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt. Put on shirt. Take out pants. Put on pants. Take out socks. Put on socks. Take out shoes. Put on shoes. Open drawer. Take out belt. Put on belt. Open bag. Place laptop in bag. Place notebook in bag. Place pen in bag. Zip bag.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the hospital for the day shift
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Put phone away. Get off bus. Walk to hospital. Enter hospital.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional, caring for patients and updating clinical records
enriched_activities.desc: Enter hospital. Change into scrubs. Wash hands. Review patient charts. Walk to patient room. Knock on door. Enter room. Greet patient. Check vital signs. Measure blood pressure. Listen to heart. Administer medication. Update clinical records. Walk to next patient room. Talk to nurse.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break at work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to cafeteria. Pick up tray. Select food. Pay for food. Sit at table. Pick up fork. Eat food. Drink water. Talk to colleague. Clear tray. Return tray. Walk back to work area.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional, attending to patients and coordinating with the care team
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to nurses' station. Check messages. Attend team meeting. Discuss patient care. Walk to patient room. Assist patient with mobility. Check IV drip. Adjust settings. Talk to patient. Document notes. Coordinate with therapist. Walk to supply room. Restock supplies. Return to nurses' station.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Check phone. Read book. Get off bus. Walk home. Enter home. Remove shoes.

Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables, meat. Close refrigerator. Wash vegetables. Cut vegetables. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add oil. Add vegetables. Stir. Add meat. Stir. Turn off stove. Serve onto plate. Sit at table. Pick up fork. Eat dinner. Sip water.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing dishes and tidying up the kitchen
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up dishes. Scrape food into trash. Open dishwasher. Load dishes. Pick up glasses. Load glasses. Close dishwasher. Turn on dishwasher. Wipe counter with cloth. Rinse cloth. Hang cloth. Sweep floor. Put broom away.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching TV and relaxing on the sofa
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Turn on TV. Pick up remote. Change channel. Sit on sofa. Put feet on ottoman. Adjust pillow. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put phone down. Get up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out snack. Close refrigerator. Walk back to living room. Sit on sofa. Eat snack. Watch TV.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking an evening shower and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on shower. Adjust temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Pick up soap. Lather body. Rinse. Pick up shampoo. Apply to hair. Rinse hair. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Hang towel. Put on pajamas. Brush teeth.

enriched_activities.activity: Using the computer to browse and unwind
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit at desk. Open laptop. Press power button. Wait for boot. Enter password. Open browser. Navigate to website. Scroll. Click link. Read. Type comment. Post comment. Close browser. Shut down laptop. Close laptop.

enriched_activities.activity: Checking phone and winding down for sleep
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up phone. Unlock. Check messages. Reply to message. Check social media. Scroll. Put phone on nightstand. Turn off lamp. Lie down. Pull blanket. Close eyes. Breathe.

Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe rhythmically. Turn to left side. Bend knees. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Stretch arms. Snore. Turn to back. Remain still. Breathe slowly. Turn to left again. Pull blanket.
